dispositions.likely-contract-or-assert-false-positive: Source evidence supports an allocator/error/output/lifetime contract; provisional, not a blanket safety guarantee.
dispositions.unresolved-needs-fixture: Not proven safe or fixed; includes high-confidence candidates awaiting a targeted fixture.

findings.message: Branch condition evaluates to a garbage value
findings.rationale: Every loaded buffers[i] is passed as an FS_ReadFile output before the final concatenation loop. The engine reader assigns either NULL or allocated file bytes; the analyzer sees an indirect callback rather than its output-write contract.

findings.message: Assigned value is garbage or undefined
findings.rationale: All four byte components of the local packed color are assigned before reading its byteAlias_t integer view. The warning appears to lose the packed-byte initialization through the cast; portability/aliasing is separate from an unwritten color component.

findings.message: Access to field 'novis' results in a dereference of a null pointer (loaded from field 'world')
findings.rationale: R_ClusterPVS tests !tr.world but returns tr.world->novis in that branch. Determine whether world-less render requests can reach this helper, then fixture that path before changing fallback semantics.

findings.message: Left shift by '32' overflows the capacity of 'int'
findings.rationale: Light/shadow counts can reach 32; 1 << 32 is undefined. The shared mask helper handles zero, partial, and full-width masks.
